facts.text: I upgraded my router to a TP-Link Archer AX50.
I bought the TP-Link Archer AX50 online from Amazon for around $150.
I have been having issues with my internet connection lately.
I am experiencing slow internet speeds.
The slow internet speeds are especially in the evening.
The slow speeds happen when multiple devices are connected.
The issues started a few days ago.
The slow internet speeds affect all devices connected to the router.
I restarted the router a few times.
Restarting the router temporarily fixed the slow internet issue.
I checked my ISP's status page.
My ISP's status page showed no reported outages or maintenance in my area.
I am not sure about the router configuration or firmware updates.
I asked for a step-by-step process to update the firmware on my TP-Link Archer AX50 router.
I believe I should download the firmware file from TP-Link's website and upload it to my router through the router's web interface.
I believe I should not interrupt the update process or turn off the router during the update.
I want to know whether there have been changes in my internet speed since upgrading to the TP-Link Archer AX50 router.
I mentioned troubleshooting steps such as checking for channel congestion or device interference.
